plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 6-date timeline completes: 6 Jan 1912 & 1915 (Wegener continental drift & Pangaea) · 1924, 15 Nov 1926 & Nov 1930 (Jeffreys & NY symposium reject Wegener; Greenland death) · Autumn 1952 & 1953 (Marie Tharp Mid-Atlantic rift & Foster earthquake overlay) · Nov 1962 (Harry Hess seafloor spreading) · 7 Sep 1963 (Vine & Matthews magnetic barcode) · Today (GPS tracks plates at 1.5–10 cm/year), alongside an inked density cross-section comparing continental granite (2.7 g/cm³) and oceanic basalt (3.0 g/cm³) floating on solid mantle rock (3.3 g/cm³).
